question: In which year did Saalumarada Thimmakka receive the Padma Shri before her passing at the age of 114?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2019.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Renowned environmentalist Saalumarada Thimmakka, who passed away at the age of 114, was honoured with the Padma Shri in 2019.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• She earned the title “Saalumarada” after planting 385 banyan trees along a 4.5 km stretch in Ramanagara district.
 
• She received 12 major awards in her lifetime, including the Padma Shri in 2019.
 
• Born on June 30, 1911, in Gubbi taluk of Tumakuru district.
 
• Recognized nationally for her lifelong contribution to environmental conservation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Padma Shri**__

 __
 
• Fourth-highest civilian award in India.
 
• Given for distinguished service in any field, including social work and environmental protection.
 
• Thimmakka received it in recognition of her exceptional environmental efforts.
 
 
 
• **Other Awards**__
 __
 
• Nadoja Award (2010) – Hampi University.
 
• National Citizen Award (1995).
 
• Indira Priyadarshini Vrikshamitra Award (1997).
 
 
 
• **Environmental Contribution**__
 __
 
• Planted and nurtured 385 banyan trees with her husband.
 
• Her work became a model for afforestation and grassroots environmental activism.
 
• Inspired millions through community-driven conservation efforts.
 
 
 
• **Legacy**__
 
 
• Lived for 114 years, becoming a symbol of environmental dedication.
 
• Celebrated globally for her lifelong commitment to tree conservation.
 
• Her contributions continue to inspire ecological initiatives across India.
